title.en: Neat breed styling and coat care

text.en: Dog owners praise the salon for neat breed-specific cuts, tidy coat trimming, and specialist hand stripping for terriers. Handlers note that pets return looking smart, well brushed, and clean. One reviewer noted an unclipped dew claw despite an otherwise good haircut, but overall styling and finish remain consistently appreciated.

Clients frequently highlight the friendly and approachable team, noting that groomers listen attentively to styling requests. Visitors appreciate the attentive guidance provided during handovers and puppy appointments in Wimbledon. Staff members are praised for their thorough work and accommodating attitude across regular grooming visits.

Reviewers repeatedly note that dogs feel comfortable and relaxed throughout their grooming appointments. Several pet parents mention that nervous pups and young dogs settle in smoothly thanks to calm handling by the team. Owners value collecting cheerful pets that show no hesitation when returning to the salon.

q.en: Does SW Dog Groomers offer breed-specific styling and hand stripping?

a.en: Yes, client reviews mention show cuts for breeds like Kerry Blue terriers as well as hand stripping for border terriers.

q.en: How do dogs typically handle grooming sessions here?

a.en: Owners report that dogs are handled gently and remain calm, with several pets visibly happy to visit during neighborhood walks.

q.en: Can puppies receive introductory grooming sessions?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently describe enrolling young pups into introductory grooming sessions to get them comfortable with coat care.
